message:
feat(homepage): ship a full multi-section landing framework for nodes (#30)

* feat(homepage): ship a full multi-section landing framework for nodes

The template homepage was a hero + 4 stats + footer — a near-empty page that
forced every new node to design a landing from scratch. Port the rich framework
the Poly and Resy nodes use, genericized, so customizing a node is words + colors,
not frontend design.

New structure (app/src/features/home):
- content.ts — single, heavily-commented customization surface: hero, agent
  stream, showcase cards, activity feed, stats. Edit values, keep shapes.
- LandingHero — animated backdrop, live status pill, gradient headline, CTAs,
  embedded AgentStream console
- AgentStream — live "agent thinking" console (looping simulated sequences)
- ShowcaseCards — eyebrow + category filter pills + card grid with split bars
- ActivityFeed — heartbeat status bar + public explainable-signal cards
- HomeStats now reads STATS from content.ts

Drops the old NewHomeHero. All sections use design tokens (primary/accent/
success/destructive) so the brand hue flows through automatically.

Docs: new-node-styling.md §4 and the node-styling skill now route homepage
customization through content.ts instead of "design a page via /frontend-design".

Preview screenshot: docs/assets/landing-page-preview.png

* refine node template landing copy

message:
fix(ai): surface upstream provider 402/5xx as provider_unavailable, not internal (#56)

Port of Cogni-DAO/cogni#1814 (bug.5056) to node-template's own packages copy.

OpenRouter 402 (operator account unfunded) and provider 5xx were normalized to
"internal" → HTTP 500 → client "Something went wrong", masking the real cause
and sending users toward a fix they cannot make.

- ai-core: distinct provider_unavailable AiExecutionErrorCode; normalize 402 + 5xx
  to it, kept separate from user-balance insufficient_credits (FAULT_PARTY_BEFORE_BUCKET).
- execution-error-mapper: provider_unavailable → HTTP 503 (both maps).
- litellm adapter: log operator-fault upstream failures (402/5xx) at error level in
  BOTH completion() and completionStream() http_error paths; benign 4xx stay at warn.
- adapter spec: assert 402/5xx log at error level.

Refs bug.5056

Co-authored-by: derekg1729 <derekgranito@gmail.com>

message:
fix(ci): node-template ≡ monorepo — pr-build trusted-dispatch for fork PRs (bug.5057) (#57)

PURGE the monorepo↔node split-brain. The operator's run-ci dispatches pr-build
(workflow_dispatch) to build a fork PR's trusted image (forks can't self-push).
The monorepo's pr-build supports this; node-template's FORBADE it via
check-node-ci-workflow.mjs — so run-ci 422'd → 502 github_op_failed on every node
(prod `games`). That forbid was split-brain, not a real provenance rule.

- pr-build.yml: add the `workflow_dispatch` trusted-build path (head_repo/head_sha
  inputs; build head_repo@head_sha, push to THIS repo's GHCR via new `checkout_repo`
  output) — identical to the monorepo. The fork `should_push=false` self-push guard
  is UNCHANGED: forks still never self-push; only the RBAC-gated operator dispatch
  builds+pushes a fork head.
- check-node-ci-workflow.mjs: stop forbidding workflow_dispatch on pr-build; instead
  REQUIRE the trusted-build inputs (head_repo, head_sha) so the contract locks the
  parity in. cancel-in-progress relaxed to an expression (never cancel push/dispatch),
  matching the monorepo.

Unblocks fork PRs → nodes (run-ci → dispatch → flightable image). Future nodes
inherit this; existing nodes need it backfilled. check:workflow passes locally.

Co-authored-by: flock-leader <flock-leader@users.noreply.github.com>

message:
feat: node self-describes identity via repo-spec → /.well-known/agent.json (#62)

Mirrors operator cogni#1830. A node now projects an `identity` block on its
public /.well-known/agent.json, sourced from its own repo-spec `intent`
(IDENTITY_IS_REPO_SPEC_PROJECTION) — never hardcoded operator-side.

- schema: intent.hook (~5-word tagline, max 80) + intent.brand.{thumbnail,color}
- accessors: extractNodeHook / extractNodeThumbnail / extractNodeBrandColor
- index: re-export the three new accessors (required for package typecheck)
- server: getNodeHook / getNodeThumbnail / getNodeBrandColor no-arg wrappers
- agent.json route: identity { name, hook, mission, brand:{thumbnail,color} }

Forks (beacon/blue/habitat/oss/red/games) inherit this via the operator's
Tier-2 substrate sync; each fork then self-describes by editing its own
repo-spec.intent (Tier-3, node-local) — untouched here.
